'''''Tecoma castanifolia''''' is a species of [[flowering plant]] native to Ecuador and Peru. Unlike some other ''Tecoma'' species, the leaves are [[simple leaf|simple]].<ref>{{citation |author=Wood, J.R.I. |year=2008 |title=A revision of ''Tecoma'' Juss. (Bignoniaceae) in Bolivia |journal=Botanical Journal of the Linnean Society |volume=156 |issue=1 |pages=143–172 |doi=10.1111/j.1095-8339.2007.00731.x|doi-access=free }}</ref>
